cases.name: Lily Stolworthy
cases.about: She was a sixth-grade student in Medical Lake School District in Medical Lake, WA.
cases.narrative: On 11/26/2023. she was found shot in the head in the middle of the road at South Prentis Street near East Kathy Lee Avenue and South Graham Road in Medical Lake, WA.
